launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=111327&key=user_uploads/208755/f101d76e-515f-4146-8bcd-78f1d81b4726)

**What is Grocalo?** 

Grocalo (S26) is an AI brain that runs content for creators. We understand their audiences, using video understanding and deep platform analytics to bottle up the taste behind each creator and personalize and distribute content to creator specific audiences.

We’re developing the most advanced AI brain capable of replicating virality for any given audience.

**We run content for top entertainers**

Grocalo generated 2B views and gained 4M followers for our creators in the last 2 months. Our clients include Jimmy O. Yang (Comedian, 11M followers), King Bach (72M followers), Leenda Dong (28M followers), Steven He (30M followers), Sheena Melwani (18M followers), and Jeannie Mai (TV host, 6M followers).

**Our team**

We have been best friends since middle-school. Alex is a 2nd time YC founder who built and sold Onederful (YC W18). David spent 5+ years in investment banking and for the last 4 years has been working with his partner to grow her content end-to-end, including generating 10B views and gaining 5M followers.

Email [team@grocalo.com](mailto:team@grocalo.com) to learn more.
